{{Top|leg}}
'''Turnik'otta''' was a thug who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Turnik'otta was sought by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:AD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Athok Dinvar|Naboo}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for the criminal [[Athok Dinvar]] escorted Turnik'otta near the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], killing two RSF security guards to protect the thug.<ref name="SWG:AD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Turnik'otta]]
Turnik'otta was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Turnik'otta spawned under the generic "thug" template, their [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and appearance were randomized under one of a 120 possible depictions during each server reset.<ref name="SWG:AD" />

Turnik'otta was involved in the fourth quest given by Athok Dinvar on Naboo. However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:AD" /><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=76216.html|text=Has Anyone Completed All the Working Static Quests?}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> For this reason, Athok Dinvar's quests were deactivated by the developers relatively early in the game's lifespan, removing Turnik'otta from the game as a result.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=game_guides&message.id=148427|text=Quests NPC all around SWG World - March 2004}}</ref>
